hypotheses.H1_gaussian_specialist: Gaussian specialization improves Gaussian causal fidelity over the universal rank-256 quotient and recovers at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb Gaussian gain.
hypotheses.H2_natural_specialist: Natural specialization improves natural causal fidelity over the universal rank-256 quotient and recovers at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb natural gain.
hypotheses.H3_cross_compatible: Each specialist remains at or above the language baseline on the other intervention and does not increase FineWeb KL by more than 0.0005 versus the universal quotient.
